title: Powerplay vs SiteFlow: Don’t Choose Until You See This Comparison
metaTitle: Powerplay vs SiteFlow: Don’t Choose Until You See This Comparison
metaDescription: Compare Powerplay and SiteFlow on BOQ-linked cost control, attendance, subcontractor billing, and procurement to pick the right construction software.
author: SiteFlow Operations Team
body: SiteFlow treats every field activity as a structured financial input, linking installed quantities, labour attendance, material consumption, and procurement to BOQ budget positions and billing readiness in real time. Powerplay focuses on daily site coordination, replacing WhatsApp updates and manual Excel tracking with centralized progress, task, and material tracking. Choose Powerplay for fast coordination-first onboarding; choose SiteFlow when daily execution must drive cost visibility and margin control.

hero.headline: SiteFlow vs Powerplay: Construction Software Comparison
hero.subhead: Powerplay centers on daily site coordination and team communication. SiteFlow turns on-site activity into structured financial input where BOQ, budgets, labour, materials, and billing operate in one linked flow.

faqs.q: What is the main difference between SiteFlow and Powerplay?
faqs.a: Powerplay is built for daily site coordination, replacing WhatsApp and Excel with a centralized platform for progress, tasks, and material tracking. SiteFlow treats every field activity as a structured financial input where installed quantities, labour, materials, and procurement connect directly to BOQ budgets and billing readiness in real time.

faqs.q: Does Powerplay support BOQ-linked cost control?
faqs.a: Powerplay provides budget planning and cost reporting, but its positioning does not center the BOQ as the structural control layer. SiteFlow builds the BOQ as the backbone of execution so budgets, procurement, progress, and billing trace back to defined BOQ line items automatically.

faqs.q: How does face recognition attendance differ between the two?
faqs.a: SiteFlow combines geo-tagged attendance with face validation and links confirmed attendance to payroll, making proxy and ghost-worker entries structurally difficult. Powerplay supports labour attendance and workforce reporting, but facial recognition is not publicly highlighted in its documentation.

faqs.q: Which is better for managing subcontractors?
faqs.a: SiteFlow provides digital work orders linked to BOQ scope, progress-based milestone billing, retention tracking, and productivity analytics. Powerplay supports task and work tracking with billing, but retention tracking is not publicly highlighted as a structured feature.
